summary: Provides a functional description of the signaling extensions needed for Generalized MPLS. GMPLS extends the MPLS control plane to time-division networks such as SONET and SDH, wavelength switching with optical lambdas, and spatial switching between ports or fibers.

eli5.summary: MPLS sets up paths for packets. GMPLS stretches that idea so it can set up paths on light colors and fibers too. This note describes what the signaling must do.
